description: This file is a shell script that implements a watchdog mechanism for monitoring and managing Beerocks processes such as beerocks_controller, beerocks_agent, and beerocks_vendor_message. It includes functions to check if programs are running, kill processes, and handle errors. The script runs an infinite loop, periodically checking process health, handling zombie processes, and logging slow-down events, with the aim of maintaining system stability and process health.
external_methods: bpl_err.sh: none explicitly called, but sourced for error handling functions

methods.name: killall_program
methods.description: Kills all processes matching a given program name, optionally with a specific signal.

methods.name: is_program_running
methods.description: Checks whether a specified program is currently running.
